mapper.select: SELECT page FROM eh_reading_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND gid = #{gid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eh_reading_progress (user_id, gid, token, page, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{gid}, #{token}, #{page}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, gid) DO UPDATE SET token = excluded.token, page = excluded.page, updated_at = now()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM eh_reading_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND gid = #{gid}
